Get Hermes reminders, scheduled jobs and alerts on this phone. You need the hermes-android plugin on your server and your own Firebase project. Hermes can guide you through it.

In console.firebase.google.com: open your project (or create one), then Project settings → Your apps → Add app → Android. Register this exact package, download google-services.json and import it here.

In the Firebase console: Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key. Upload that JSON here. It goes straight to your server over this app\'s connection. Never send it through the chat.

Install the Hermes Android plugin from %1$s and set up notifications for my Android phone. Follow its hermes-android:setup skill.
Set up Android notifications: the hermes-android plugin says the API server is not reachable from my phone. Follow the hermes-android:setup skill.
Configure the hermes-android plugin so I can pair my Android phone (run hermes_android_configure and restart the gateway when I confirm).

Firebase rejected this phone\'s registration. The usual cause is the API key in your project: in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials, open the Android key (auto created by Firebase) and set Application restrictions to None, or to Android apps including %1$s with this app\'s signing certificate. A website (HTTP referrer) restriction blocks the app. Then pair again.
FCM refused the server key. The service-account key and google-services.json must come from the same Firebase project, with Cloud Messaging API (V1) enabled.
